data.title: Unified Security Operations Centers (911): Strengthening Proactive Security and Quality of Life in Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Unified Security Operations Centers (911), affiliated with the National Center for Security Operations (NCSO) at the Ministry of Interior, have reinforced their pivotal role in providing assistance and support to everyone living in Saudi Arabia. Their services contribute to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 under the Quality of Life Program.
    The centers operate through an integrated system that consolidates emergency services under a single number. This enables an immediate response to security, humanitarian, and service-related calls from people of all nationalities.
    The 911 system operates across Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and Eastern regions. It has consolidated 166 operations rooms into one location and extended its coverage to 59 governorates, in addition to the four major cities of Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and Dammam. This has improved service efficiency, strengthened public confidence, helped protect lives and property, saved time and effort, and ensured a swift response to incidents.
    The Unified Security Operations Centers (911) have also helped establish a proactive approach to security by identifying warning signs before incidents occur. This supports efforts to strengthen sustainable security and safety through modern technological systems and television surveillance rooms equipped with high-resolution cameras.
    These systems are operated by qualified Saudi personnel who speak several international languages. They handle incoming reports within a response time of no more than two seconds and forward them to the relevant authorities within 45 seconds. All calls and reports are handled with complete confidentiality, without placing any liability on the reporting party.
    The Ministry of Interior continues to expand the network of Unified Security Operations Centers (911) across the Kingdom's remaining regions. These efforts aim to provide security and humanitarian services that meet international standards, drawing on national expertise and supporting long-term sustainability.
    -- SPA
